method: Coordinator independently fetched the actual entries after both blind initial reports were archived and both reviewer processes exited. Concise evidence paraphrases, not full dictionary reproduction.

sources.heading: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten: あん‐ず【杏子・杏】
sources.evidence: The actual noun entry identifies あん and す as the 唐宋音 of 杏 and 子 respectively. Its word-history section explains extension of the borrowed fruit name to the tree and flowers. Relevant entry and history returned fully; some other dictionary panels expose only headings.

sources.heading: Nipponica: アンズ あんず / 杏子
sources.evidence: The actual lexical-history paragraph explicitly identifies アンズ as 杏子の唐音. Botanical origin alone would not establish word origin; this paragraph does.

disposition: Correct only the new 杏 teaching: replace native-noun assertion with standalone plant noun, use kango type/tag for Chinese-derived lexical identity, explain why preserved KANJIDIC2 kun classification does not establish native lexical origin, link the actual noun source. No reading/order/curation/word identity/primary reading/level/exclusion/stroke change. No reopening unchanged baseline 梅.
limits: This supports a narrow lexical-origin distinction, not historical phonetic reconstruction, new component readings, universal classification across frameworks, fresh native/phone evidence or publication. Both original sessions still need bounded changed-passage confirmation.
